flow.caption_zh: 茱麗葉故居的陽台.  Verona, Italy

en: Carrying the classical
A memory like drama
And that stretch below Banping Mountain
Golden rice ears when autumn comes
I traveled a thousand miles to come to Verona

zh: 陰霾天氣宛若迷朦晨曉
有一種似曾相識的感覺
en: In the afternoon just after the fine rain has stopped
Walking into days gone by
You and Romeo
The courtyard where we parted, reluctant
The balcony remains as it was
The window remains, empty
Overcast weather, like a hazy, dim dawn
Vines dampened by the rain
There is a feeling of déjà vu
But, Juliet
Figures stir restlessly in the courtyard
So many voices, such clamor
Let me search awhile
A quiet, secluded corner
Listening once more to your halting, murmured hum:
"Parting is such sweet sorrow...... "

zh: 踏著雨後的石板路離去
連同那一段青澀無悔的歲月
en: And then
Departing along the flagstone road after rain
Together with those unripe, unregretted years

points.zh: **   記得大學時代讀莎士比亞文集時 ，高雄醫學院後面那一片廣裘的稻田，彷彿一直綿延到半屏山腳下。

Juliet: “Yet I should kill thee with much cherishing.  Good night, good night; Parting is such sweet sorrow that I shall say good night till it be tomorrow.“        
                                                       -- Romeo and Juliet: 2. 2
